Previously-hidden apps surfaced: device-strategy, ind-authoring, cmc, report-engine, regulatory-intelligence (RIM), csr-intelligence, protocol-designer, device-engineering, dossier-navigator, ectd-navigator, document-vault, sop-management, capa-management, post-market, inspection-readiness, compliance-monitor, evidence-engine. Nav handler extended with two new resolver paths: (a) tool-panel mapping for apps that live as project-scoped drawers (ectd, protocol, sop, capa, pms, inspection, intelligence, vault); (b) seed-chat starters for apps that open project-home with an AnA-contextual prompt (device-strategy, ind-authoring, cmc, safety-narrative, report-engine, csr-intelligence, device-engineering, dossier-navigator, compliance-monitor, evidence-engine). All 25 cards visible (disabled if no active project). No new component files.
